Accessibility Statement

DRAFT — pending review. Last updated: 9 August 2026.

Our commitment

Kraal Code is committed to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities. We aim to conform to the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2 Level AA.

Current status

This website was designed with accessibility as a core requirement. We have implemented:

  • Semantic HTML structure with proper heading hierarchy
  • Skip-to-content link for keyboard users
  • Keyboard-operable navigation and menus
  • Visible focus indicators on all interactive elements
  • Sufficient colour contrast (minimum 4.5:1 for text)
  • Text alternatives for meaningful images
  • Responsive design that supports text zoom to 200%
  • Reduced motion support via prefers-reduced-motion

Known limitations

We are aware of the following accessibility limitations:

  • Product screenshots (when added) will require alt text review
  • Form validation error messages may need improved screen reader association
  • Some interactive elements may not have been tested with all screen readers

We are working to address these in future updates.

Feedback

If you encounter accessibility barriers on this website, please contact us at info@kraalcode.com. We take all feedback seriously and will respond within 5 business days.

Assessment methodology

Accessibility is assessed through automated testing (axe-core), keyboard navigation testing, and manual review against WCAG 2.2 AA criteria.
